blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY—A remote monitoring station critical to tracking Kanlaon Volcano’s unrest has resumed operations after vandals cut cables connecting its equipment to solar panels, temporarily disrupting the transmission of monitoring data. The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) detected the interruption on Nov. 13 at its VKMH observation station in Sitio Manghumay, Barangay Mailum,
